## Core Domains of Expertise

### 1. AI Services & Production Architectures
- **Problem Solved**: Most AI prototypes function well in sandbox demos but break under concurrency, API rate-limits, unexpected hallucinations, and spiraling token costs.
- **Engineering Approach**:
  - **Multi-Agent Orchestration**: Implementation of LangGraph StateGraph architectures where distinct agents (e.g. Ingestion, Reasoning, Critique, Citation) execute with independent state contexts.
  - **Deterministic Guardrails**: Pre-execution input sanitization and post-generation schema validation via Pydantic and regex verification to eliminate hallucinations.
  - **Multi-Model Failover**: Seamless switching between frontier models (OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet via AWS Bedrock) with exponential backoff and jitter.
  - **Observability & Tracing**: End-to-end token auditing, latency tracing, and cost attribution via LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, and structured JSON logs.

### 2. Autonomous AI Workflows
- **Problem Solved**: Unstructured prompt chains fail silently and cannot be audited or rolled back when an external tool call fails.
- **Engineering Approach**:
  - **State Machine Modeling**: Treating every step in an AI workflow as a distinct state transition with explicit inputs, outputs, and timeouts.
  - **Resilient Queuing**: Integrating RabbitMQ, Celery, and AWS SQS dead-letter queues to catch failed agent executions without crashing client sessions.
  - **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL)**: Embedding review checkpoints for financial transactions, data mutations, and public-facing content generation.

### 3. SaaS Applications & Multi-Tenant Architecture
- **Problem Solved**: Scaling SaaS platforms from prototype to thousands of concurrent users requires strict concurrency guarantees, transaction isolation, and predictable payment reconciliation.
- **Engineering Approach**:
  - **Concurrency Safety**: Implementing Redis Distributed Locks (Redlock) to prevent race conditions during scheduling runs and resource reservation.
  - **Payment Integration**: Complete Stripe Connect architectures supporting automated payouts, split payments, webhook idempotency, and ledger balance verification.
  - **Database Scalability**: Relational schema normalization, read replicas, connection pooling with PgBouncer, and index optimization in PostgreSQL.

### 4. High-Performance Web Development
- **Problem Solved**: Slow, unoptimized web applications lose user trust and degrade search rankings.
- **Engineering Approach**:
  - **Modern Stack**: Next.js 15 (App Router, Server Components), TypeScript, React 19, Vanilla CSS Modules.
  - **Global Delivery**: Static asset pre-rendering and edge deployment via Cloudflare Workers & Pages for sub-50ms global TTFB.
  - **Bespoke Visuals**: Three.js and React Three Fiber interactive 3D command center components with responsive fallback support.

## Detailed Case Studies & Production Proof

### Case Study 1: Wellows — Multi-Agent AI Search Visibility Platform
- **URL**: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/wellows/
- **Role**: Founding Architect
- **Challenge**: The prototype worked for single-query investor demos but suffered from cascading failures, lack of async queuing, and uncontrolled OpenAI API costs when concurrent users initiated search visibility audits across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity.
- **Architecture**:
  - Partitioned workflow into three isolated agents: **KIVA** (keyword discovery), **OPTA** (technical auditing), and **Citation Intelligence** (cross-LLM brand citation monitoring).
  - Orchestrated via LangGraph with bounded MemorySaver sessions.
  - Vector search retrieval layer using chunked embedding pipelines with sub-200ms latency.
  - AWS Bedrock failover to Claude 3.5 Sonnet when OpenAI limits were approached.
  - SQS dead-letter queues for unrecoverable crawl errors.

### Case Study 2: ClassFlow — Autonomous Online Learning SaaS
- **URL**: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/classflow/
- **Role**: Lead Architect
- **Challenge**: The business was burdened by manual teacher-student matching runs, double-booking race conditions during peak hours, and manual payment disbursement calculations.
- **Architecture**:
  - Built an automated matchmaking state machine in FastAPI calculating multi-factor weights (timezones, subject affinity, historical ratings).
  - Enforced Redis Redlock distributed mutexes to guarantee zero double-bookings.
  - Automated Stripe Connect ledger reconciliation, moving 100% of payment workflows into background queues.

### Case Study 3: Savyour — High-Throughput Cashback & Affiliate Fintech
- **URL**: https://uzairkhatri.com/work/savyour/
- **Role**: Senior Engineering Lead
- **Challenge**: Reconciling millions of affiliate transactions across multiple e-commerce networks without double-credit errors or ledger imbalance during flash sales.
- **Architecture**:
  - Event-driven transaction ledger with PostgreSQL atomic row locks.
  - Asynchronous worker pipeline using Celery and Redis to handle peak throughput.
  - Transparent audit trail tracking transaction status from pending to paid.
